methods.Initialize:
if B < 2 or B > 5 or (UseCONWIP and K < 1)
    ValidationError := "Invalid B or K"
    EventController.stop
    return
end
WIP := 0
NIn := 0
NOut := 0
Completed := 0
MeasuredAdmissions := 0
CohortCompleted := 0
BufferN := 0
OutsideN := 0
WIPArea := 0
BufferArea := 0
OutsideArea := 0
ResidenceSum := 0
OutsideWaitSum := 0
LastChange := 0
RunFinished := false
ValidationError := ""
A_MoveIn.entranceLocked := false
&StartStats.executeIn(Warmup)
&EndStats.executeIn(Warmup + MeasureTime)
methods.Touch:
var a: time := LastChange
var b: time := EventController.simTime
if a < Warmup then a := Warmup end
if b > Warmup + MeasureTime then b := Warmup + MeasureTime end
if b > a
    WIPArea := WIPArea + WIP * (b-a)
    BufferArea := BufferArea + BufferN * (b-a)
    OutsideArea := OutsideArea + OutsideN * (b-a)
end
LastChange := EventController.simTime
methods.Admit:
Touch
@.createAttr("EnteredAt", "time")
@.createAttr("InBuffer", "boolean")
@.EnteredAt := EventController.simTime
@.InBuffer := false
WIP := WIP + 1
NIn := NIn + 1
OutsideN := OutsideN - 1
if EventController.simTime >= Warmup and EventController.simTime < Warmup + MeasureTime
    MeasuredAdmissions := MeasuredAdmissions + 1
    OutsideWaitSum := OutsideWaitSum + EventController.simTime - @.OutsideAt
end
A_MoveIn.entranceLocked := UseCONWIP and WIP >= K
CheckWIP
methods.Depart:
Touch
WIP := WIP - 1
NOut := NOut + 1
var t: time := EventController.simTime
if t >= Warmup and t < Warmup + MeasureTime
    Completed := Completed + 1
    if @.EnteredAt >= Warmup
        ResidenceSum := ResidenceSum + t - @.EnteredAt
        CohortCompleted := CohortCompleted + 1
    end
end
A_MoveIn.entranceLocked := UseCONWIP and WIP >= K
CheckWIP
methods.CheckWIP:
if WIP < 0 or WIP /= NIn - NOut or (UseCONWIP and WIP > K)
    ValidationError := "WIP conservation or cap violation"
    EventController.stop
end
methods.BufferArrival:
if not @.InBuffer
    Touch
    @.InBuffer := true
    BufferN := BufferN + 1
end
methods.LiftRoute:
var destination: object
if B = 2
    destination := Slot4
elseif B = 3
    destination := Slot3
elseif B = 4
    destination := Slot2
else
    destination := Slot1
end
@.move(destination)
methods.EndStats:
Touch
TH := Completed * 3600.0 / MeasureTime
MeanWIP := WIPArea / MeasureTime
MeanBuffer := BufferArea / MeasureTime
MeanOutside := OutsideArea / MeasureTime
BlockSeconds := A_MoveOut.statBlockingTime - BlockStart
WaitSeconds := C_665.statWaitingTime - WaitStart
CheckWIP
RunFinished := ValidationError = ""
print "B=", B, " K=", K, " CONWIP=", UseCONWIP
print "Throughput/hour=", TH, " MeanWIP=", MeanWIP
print "MeanBuffer=", MeanBuffer, " OutsideQueueMean=", MeanOutside
print "Entry cohort unfinished=", MeasuredAdmissions - CohortCompleted
EventController.stop
